game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Misty Bog, a misty bog: the forest ranger must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Stride Selector: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones.
theme: Mystic Forest – Misty Bog: a misty bog
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Preprocessor directives: build a valid C source file that prints 6. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the splitter at (2, 3), with the upper processing path on row 1 and lower path on row 6. Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Assemble components on both paths, then merge them at (8, 3) before the shared output. Deliver exactly 5 components (3 upper, 2 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 5.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stride Selector' (Week 5 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Misty Bog'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Protect the seed vault from bog toads in Misty Bog: keep the stones meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 50-second timer ends.
source_lose_condition: stones drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
hint: Alternate items between A (upper) and B (lower); wait if the scheduled branch is blocked. Assemble components on both paths, then merge them at (8, 3) before the shared output. Branch contracts: A: 3 components via upper_4, upper_6 to output_shared; B: 2 components via lower_4, lower_6 to output_shared. Power the junctions and production machines. A blocked branch waits without losing items.
